title: Register bounds imply the guard
statement: Let $a,b,f,B$ be natural numbers, let $m$ be a Boolean mode, let $o$ be an oracle on five deciders and bit strings, and let $y$ be a bit string. If a fifteen-register state $st$ has every register value at most $B$, then for every program label $l$, the abstract configuration with label $l$, register values given by $st$, and no Boolean result satisfies the guard: its registers are all at most $B$ and its instruction-specific precondition holds.
hypotheses_covered: $o$ is an oracle on five deciders and bit strings
$st$ has all fifteen registers at most $B$
replaced:
Let $a,b,f$ be natural numbers, let $A$ be the specified register program with
parameters $a,b,f$ and mode $\mathrm{mode}$, and let $o$ be an oracle and $y$ a bit

program label $l$, the configuration with label $l$, register values given by
